build_vdn_algorithm: build a VDN algorithm instance with delay value and loss function for multi-agent reinforcement learning
create_vdn_mixer: create a VDN mixer TensorDictModule that aggregates chosen action values across agents in a group
get_vdn_loss_module: get a QMixerLoss module with TD0 value estimator for the VDN algorithm on discrete action spaces
build_vdn_policy_for_loss: build a TensorDictSequential policy with actor and QValueModule for computing VDN loss on a group
configure_vdn_algorithm: configure a VdnConfig dataclass with delay value and loss function settings for the VDN algorithm
